name: KRETAM
recent: Kretam 近期出现一系列董事会与委员会人事变动，Chiong 家族成员加入董事会，执行主席 Yin Kong Fung 辞职。同时，公司有多项大股东股权变动申报。最新财报显示季度营收环比增长 42.9%，但录得净亏损 970.8 万令吉。
notable: 执行主席 Yin Kong Fung 辞职，Chiong Yong Foo 加入董事会。
Chiong 家族成员进入董事会，同时出现多项大股东股权变动申报。
公司发布最新季度财报，营收环比增长 42.9%，但录得净亏损。
risks: 最新季度录得净亏损 970.8 万令吉，净利率为 -3.7%。
董事会及多个委员会出现密集人事变动。
大股东 Chiong Yong Foo 与 Chiong Hang Leong 近期有多项股权变动申报。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2.601 亿令吉，环比增长 42.9%，同比增长 38.8%；净亏损 970.8 万令吉，净利率 -3.7%，上季净利率为 2.8%。

recent_en: Kretam has seen a series of board and committee changes, with Chiong family members joining the board and executive chairman Yin Kong Fung resigning. There were also several substantial shareholder interest change filings. The latest quarterly results show revenue up 42.9% QoQ but a net loss of MYR 9.708 million.
notable_en: Executive chairman Yin Kong Fung resigned and Chiong Yong Foo joined the board.
Chiong family members joined the board, alongside several substantial shareholder interest change filings.
The company released its latest quarterly results with revenue up 42.9% QoQ but a net loss.
risks_en: The latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 9.708 million with a net margin of -3.7%.
There were密集 board and committee changes.
Substantial shareholders Chiong Yong Foo and Chiong Hang Leong made multiple interest change filings recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 260.137 million, up 42.9% QoQ and 38.8% YoY; net loss was MYR 9.708 million with a net margin of -3.7%, versus a net margin of 2.8% in the previous quarter.
